_comment: Fantasy coupling (H3). A werewolf is NOT moon-only: the moon draws the change near, but a hormone cycle and heightened emotion (fear, rage, desire) can also force it — and the player picks which levers are live via `playstyle`. `pressure` sources sum to 0..1; a shift fires past `shift_at`, a reversion below `revert_below`. Vampires get a night/sun ambient instead.

profiles._comment: The draw is a partial shift (fur, nails, senses) that rises with the moon; the full shift is a temporary form. Emotion/hormone can force either.

full.note: the moon draws it, but fear, rage and the body's own cycle can force it — the intended default

classic.note: full moon only; the traditional curse

emotional.note: the moon plus strong feeling — stress, terror, fury

hormonal.note: the moon plus her own cycle

voluntary.note: as emotional, and — once she has realized the change — she may call the shift on purpose

profiles._comment: Night restores, sun wearies; a feeding/thirst cycle adds pressure. No forced shift — the change is permanent, the ambient is the tell.

full.note: night and feeding need shape the change
